name: NaturalReader
tagline: Text-to-speech that reads documents, web pages and ebooks aloud in natural voices.
about: NaturalReader converts written text into speech. It is used for listening to documents and for study, with separate plans for commercial voiceover.
pros: Reads PDFs, documents, web pages and scanned text.
Web app, mobile apps and a browser extension.
cons: The most natural voices are limited on the free plan.
Commercial voiceover needs a separate licence.
